definition: A waymark document inside the repository that carries local work state; both map and task are tickets. A record item is a waymark document too, but it is not a ticket.
avoid: issue (issues live on a remote tracker, not in the repository)

definition: A waymark document that records a discussion or a decision rather than work; testimony is a record item.
avoid: ticket (when the meaning is a work item)

definition: An item on a remote issue tracker, outside the repository: a work item on that tracker or a message to a teammate. It is not local state.
The record of a grill: the question tree and what a person said while a decision was discussed, including the alternatives that lost. It is a waymark record item, not a work item.
avoid: attachment (when it implies a work item)

definition: The grill's refinement tree of open questions, where a child is a narrower part of its parent and siblings are parallel.
avoid: design tree (ambiguous with the target tree)

definition: The questions in the question tree whose prerequisites are settled, asked together in one round.
avoid: frontier (that is the waymark work frontier)

definition: A target node that answers 'what I want': an expected outcome or requirement, refined by child maps or tasks. Every target node is a map, and the root map is the overall goal.
avoid: milestone (when it implies a fixed point in time)

definition: The finest level of the target tree: a target refined to one executable action with an auditable result.
avoid: ticket (when the meaning is broader than this project's unit of work)
action item (when it refers to an action without a result)

definition: The layered refinement from the root map to tasks, where parent-child is part-whole and order comes only from dependency edges between maps.
A relation between maps that carries order: one map waits for another to finish. The edge gates the waiting map's acceptance, not every task under it.
avoid: prerequisite (when the direction is not made explicit)

definition: A map whose own dependency edge is unfinished; the edge gates the map's acceptance, not every task under it.
avoid: blocked (for a task waiting on a person; that is `waiting_on`)

definition: The relation between a parent target and a child target, where the child is a more specific statement of the parent.
avoid: breakdown (when it implies slicing once into executable pieces)

definition: Splitting a broad question into narrower sub-questions in the question tree.
avoid: split (when the question tree is meant)

definition: The moment a settled decision becomes a child node, as a task when one action and result can be written, otherwise as a child map.
avoid: splitting (when they mean a fog item becoming a node rather than slicing work)

definition: Turning one map's next layer into child maps or tasks.
Moving a settled question to the target tree as work; the work item hangs under a map, not the testimony.
Opening a child ticket under a node, recorded by the child's parent field.
avoid: attach (when it implies linking, not creating)
mount (when it implies a different tree)
add to Children (there is no such list)

definition: Resolving a map's fog: turning an undecided item into a decision, a clearance, or something left for split.
avoid: grill (an interview method, not the act itself)

definition: An operation an owner performs on their own work item: changing its content, relations, status, or ownership.
avoid: modify (when the actor is not specified)

definition: The branch of advance that changes a node other nodes already rely on, sorted by two tests into edit in place, strike and reopen, or retire and replace.
avoid: advance (when such a node's content is meant)
move (a move is one kind of update, not a synonym)

definition: Relocating a subtree under another parent without changing its content; only the moved node's parent field is written.
avoid: migrate (when the means is a rebuild)
re-parent (of a whole subtree — only the top node is written)

definition: The accountable party of a ticket: the person who advances it and decides whether it passes.
avoid: author (when the accountable party is meant)
assignee (a claim changes who is advancing, not who owns)

definition: Making an open task in_progress, the state of being advanced; a claim does not change the owner.
avoid: assign (when it implies changing the owner)

definition: A task advanced against a committed output, where failure is an incident.
avoid: formal task (when contrasted with a probe)

definition: A task that trades the smallest reversible action for information, where failure is a normal result.
avoid: exploration (when referring to a vague phase without concrete actions)

definition: The cost of undoing a task after it goes wrong; a one-way door needs confirmation before acting, a two-way door does not.
avoid: risk (when referring to probability rather than undo cost)

definition: An observable criterion written before work starts to distinguish done, not done, and cannot judge yet.
avoid: acceptance criteria (when it is only a checklist)

definition: An entry in a map's Not yet specified section: in-scope content not yet specific enough to become a decision, child, task, or exclusion.
avoid: open question (when the content is already scoped to a map)

definition: The set of work items with no unfinished dependencies that can be started now.
avoid: next actions (when referring to a personal list)
askable set (the grill's questions are not work)

definition: One stage of a result, finished before anything downstream can use it; it needs a sibling to mean anything.
avoid: phase (when describing work that has no result of its own)

definition: One numbered line inside a task's Action; it has no acceptance signal and is never a target-tree node.
A delivery task's failure: the promised output is missing or short of its acceptance signal, so someone must recover.
avoid: error (when describing the contractual weight of a failed delivery)

definition: Whether a map or task can be started now, judged by its own unfinished dependencies rather than a blocked ancestor.
avoid: scheduling (readiness is about waiting, not about order of importance)

definition: An optional task field naming the one person whose answer the task waits on now; it is not a status or a dependency edge.
avoid: assign (the field names a wait, not an owner)

definition: A symmetric association between two items that marks something worth following and carries no order.
The YAML header block of a ticket, carrying the structured fields while the map sections are body text.
avoid: header (when it means the body's heading)
metadata block (when the actor is not specified)

definition: A remote issue carrying one message between two owners in this project's format: its body opens with frontmatter naming the sender, the single recipient, the related tickets, and the message category. It is not local state; the ticket it names is where any decision lands.
avoid: message (when the meaning is the issue itself)

definition: A pass over the whole project that reports where two targets, a promise and its artifact, or two rules contradict each other, into one report, and changes no ticket. The read that steps out of the current ticket; it judges nothing.

The file written before a restart, listing what still holds, which words and decisions survive, and the dead ends not to repeat. It is what the new root cites and what a reader of the failed attempt opens.

Two parts of a project that contradict each other: two targets, a promise and its artifact, or two rules. It has to name both sides and be citable at each; one side alone is a preference, not a conflict.
